title: 降价后销量上升、销售额下降，怎样把结果讲清楚？
topic: 用销量、顾客数和销售额解释价格策略

source.title: 降价后销量上升、销售额下降，怎样把结果讲清楚？
source.type: IKEA 官方年度销售业绩报道
source.context: 用销量、顾客数和销售额解释价格策略
paragraphs: Over the last two years, IKEA has invested in 10% lower prices to make well-designed, functional home furnishings more affordable for people around the world. In financial year 2025 (FY25), this contributed to a 3% increase in both sales volumes and customers.

Inter IKEA Group today announced total IKEA retail sales of EUR 44.6 billion for FY25, compared to EUR 45.1 billion in FY24 (-1.0% compared to FY24, currency adjusted -0.3%). Total retail sales include sales of IKEA products, food, and services by the 13 groups of IKEA franchisees worldwide. IKEA continues to strengthen its commitment to affordability, accessibility and sustainability for the many people.

During FY25, 66 new sales locations opened worldwide. These ranged from smaller formats to full-size stores and plan and order points. Visitation to stores rose to 915 million from 899 million – the fifth consecutive year of growth.

Looking ahead, IKEA will focus its FY26 commercial activities on kitchen and dining products. In anticipation, IKEA launched the new low-price KNOXHULT kitchen series, and early results are already exceeding expectations.
translations: 过去两年，IKEA 投入资源将价格降低 10%，让更多人买得起设计实用的家居产品。2025 财年，这一策略带动销量和顾客人数都增长了 3%。
Inter IKEA Group 公布，2025 财年零售销售额为 446 亿欧元，低于 2024 财年的 451 亿欧元，按汇率调整后下降 0.3%。这里的零售销售额包括全球 13 个加盟集团销售的家居产品、食品和服务。
2025 财年，IKEA 在全球新开了 66 个销售地点，从小型门店到大型门店以及规划和订购中心都有。门店到访人数从 8.99 亿升至 9.15 亿，连续第五年增长。
展望未来，IKEA 将把 2026 财年的商业重点放在厨房和餐饮产品上。为此，公司推出了低价 KNOXHULT 厨房系列，早期表现已超过预期。
fullTextParagraphs: Over the last two years, IKEA has invested in 10% lower prices to make well-designed, functional home furnishings more affordable for people around the world. In financial year 2025 (FY25), this contributed to a 3% increase in both sales volumes and customers.

Inter IKEA Group today announced total IKEA retail sales of EUR 44.6 billion for FY25, compared to EUR 45.1 billion in FY24 (-1.0% compared to FY24, currency adjusted -0.3%). Total retail sales include sales of IKEA products, food, and services by the 13 groups of IKEA franchisees worldwide. IKEA continues to strengthen its commitment to affordability, accessibility and sustainability for the many people.

“Making IKEA more affordable for the many people is central to who we are,” says Jon Abrahamsson Ring, CEO, Inter IKEA Group. “Our long-term approach has allowed us to reduce prices by 10% over the past two years. Now we see the results in higher volumes and more customers.”

During FY25, 66 new sales locations opened worldwide. These ranged from smaller formats to full-size stores and plan and order points. Visitation to stores rose to 915 million from 899 million – the fifth consecutive year of growth.

“Since 2020, IKEA sales have grown faster than the overall home furnishing market, resulting in increased market share. During that time, we’ve worked hard to offset inflation while continuing to transform the IKEA business. We are helping more people by making our products even more affordable for the many people,” says Jon Abrahamsson Ring.
The strategy remains to launch new products at lower recommended retail prices than existing ones – a trend that will continue in the years ahead.

Behind the scenes, IKEA continued to introduce new production methods that reduce waste and emissions while maintaining quality and low price. One example is the MITTZON desk – made from lightweight steel that reduces material use and transport emissions.

E-commerce continues to transform the home furnishing market, with online sales now accounting for 28% of IKEA turnover. Furthermore, upcoming new market entries to Panama and Costa Rica will strengthen the IKEA Brand presence in the Americas.

The commercial focus for FY25 was bedroom products, including furniture, textiles, and accessories. One highlight was the launch of a new PAX wardrobe range, which is easier to assemble, disassemble and re-assemble. These changes make PAX more durable and easier to move – extending its lifetime and re-usability.
Overall IKEA product sales were strongest in furniture, particularly storage solutions and kitchens. Well-established European markets led this development.

Looking ahead, IKEA will focus its FY26 commercial activities on kitchen and dining products. In anticipation, IKEA launched the new low-price KNOXHULT kitchen series, and early results are already exceeding expectations.

“I am proud of the 222,000 IKEA co-workers around the world. Your dedication and passion have been the driving force behind our achievements in FY25. Thanks to your relentless efforts, we’ve achieved high product availability, stable sales and great new products. Now we’re better prepared to drive growth than we have been in a very long time,” adds Jon Abrahamsson Ring.

scenario.title: 向产品团队解释促销后的业绩
english: An online retailer reduced prices across selected home products.
Customer numbers and units sold rose, but total sales revenue was slightly lower than last year.
Write a short update that separates volume from revenue and suggests what the team should review next.
chinese: 一家线上零售商下调了部分家居产品的价格。
顾客人数和销量上升，但总销售额略低于去年。
请写一条简短更新，区分销量和营收，并说明团队接下来应复查什么。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请给零售业务团队写三句话：说明 IKEA 为什么降价、顾客与销量有什么变化，以及总销售额的表现。
firstAttempt.sample: IKEA reduced prices by 10% over two years to make its products more affordable. In FY25, both sales volumes and customer numbers rose by 3%. Total retail sales were EUR 44.6 billion, down from EUR 45.1 billion in FY24.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把策略、销量与客流、总销售额分开写，避免把销量增长误说成营收增长。

structure.original: In financial year 2025 (FY25), this contributed to a 3% increase in both sales volumes and customers.
analysis: contributed to 连接策略和结果，但表示“有助于”，不等同于唯一原因。
both…and… 表示销量和顾客人数两项都增长。
structure.transfer: The new bundle contributed to a 5% increase in both orders and repeat customers.

rewrite.bad: IKEA cut prices and sales went up.
rewrite.good: IKEA reduced prices by 10% over two years to make its products more affordable. In FY25, both sales volumes and customer numbers rose by 3%. Total retail sales were EUR 44.6 billion, down from EUR 45.1 billion in FY24.
rewrite.translation: IKEA 在两年内降价 10%，让产品更容易负担。2025 财年，销量和顾客人数均增长 3%。零售总销售额为 446 亿欧元，低于 2024 财年的 451 亿欧元。
rewrite.pattern: We changed [price/offer] to [goal]. [Volume/customer metric] rose by [x]. Total sales came to [amount], compared with [prior period].

translationPractice.why: sales volume 指售出的数量，不是销售额。

choice.prompt: 销量上升 3%，总销售额从 451 亿欧元降到 446 亿欧元。哪种汇报最准确？
options: Revenue grew by 3%, because more items were sold.
Sales volume rose by 3%, while total retail sales were slightly lower year over year.
choice.why: 销量和销售额是不同指标。第二句分别报告两项，不把一个指标当成另一个。

output.prompt: 一家服装零售商降价 8% 后，销量增长 5%、顾客数增长 4%，销售额同比下降 2%。请写三句话说明策略与结果，并指出下一步应关注什么。
output.sample: We reduced prices by 8% to make selected products more affordable. Sales volume rose by 5% and customer numbers increased by 4%, while total sales were down 2% year over year. We should now review product mix and margins to understand the revenue change.
